title: Nautiloid Tank
summary: Fire detonates the tank for 6d6 Fire in a 20 ft radius and knocks creatures back.

fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft. Breaks to spill Mysterious Liquid. Throwing or placing it on fire detonates it.
fields.Explosion: Fire damage to the intact tank triggers a 20 ft radius blast for 6d6 Fire. DC 12 Dexterity save for half. Creatures in the blast are knocked back 10 ft without a save.
fields.Mysterious Liquid: Fire ignites the spilled liquid, applies Burning and leaves a Fire surface.
fields.Acquisition: Prologue Nautiloid, Ghustil Stornugoss’s office at Crèche Y’llek, Mind Flayer Colony and High Hall.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
